# Joey Shea

> Computer Science & Data Science student at the Jeffrey S. Raikes School (University of Nebraska–Lincoln) and a software engineering intern at Garmin. Builds LLM-powered tools, full-stack applications, and data projects.

This is the personal portfolio and résumé of Joey Shea. Contact: 27josephs@gmail.com.

## Projects

- [Grafle](https://grafle.xyz): A free, live game that teaches you to recognize the world's languages and writing systems at a glance. Built with React, Vite, Leaflet, and Supabase.
- [Travela (source)](https://github.com/joeyShea/travel-map): A full-featured travel review platform designed and deployed in a 24-hour hackathon. Next.js, AWS (RDS, S3, ECR).
- [Stock Dashboard (source)](https://github.com/joeyShea/StockDashboard): A live terminal dashboard for markets and Federal Reserve data, pulling from FRED and Yahoo Finance. Python.
